test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A place to play games and bet on them
solution: The correct answer is "**Casino**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options: • **The one-word substitute for "a place to play games and bet on them" is "Casino"**. • a place where people play games in which you can win or lose money, such as roulette. (ऐसा स्‍थान जहाँ खेल खेलकर पैसा जीता या हारा जा सकता है; जुआघर, कैसीनो) • Example: Bengaluru man wins 10 lakh rupees in a casino in Goa. Hence, it can be concluded that **the correct answer is option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • On the other hand the other option means: • "Motel" is a type of lodging establishment.(कार-यात्रियों के लिए मुख्‍य सड़क के निकट बना होटल; मोटल) • "Hotel" is a lodging establishment that offers more amenities than a motel.(विश्रामालय) • "Pub" is a place where alcoholic beverages are served.(अतिथिशाला) 12d:T89a, The correct answer is "**Karan call the restaurant**".
